```{r, warning = F, echo = F, eval = T}
#### Translate
translate_DNA <- function(dna_data){
  clean_dna <- gsub("[^ACTG]", "", dna_data)
  DNA_strings <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(clean_dna)
  translations <- as.character(Biostrings::translate(DNA_strings))
  return(translations)
}

#### Trim CDR3
trim_CDR3 <- function(seq_vec){
  return(substr(seq_vec, 2, nchar(seq_vec)-1))
}

top_groups <- function(results, clone_var){
  return(table(results[[clone_var]])[order(table(results[[clone_var]]), decreasing = T)])
}

unproductive <- function(results){
  return(results[which(!grepl("\\*", results$VHH, fixed = F)),])
}

```

## Load Databases

```{r}
S3 <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Old Data/S3_specificity_test_clone-pass.tsv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')
S3$experiment <- rep("S3", each = nrow(S3))
S3$clone_id <- paste(S3$clone_id, "-S3", sep = '')

F13 <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/13_VecF1_R2_S13_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')
F13$experiment <- rep("F13", each = nrow(F13))
F13$clone_id <- paste(F13$clone_id, "-F13", sep = '')

F14 <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/14_VecF1_R2_S14_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')
F14$experiment <- rep("F14", each = nrow(F14))
F14$clone_id <- paste(F14$clone_id, "-F14", sep = '')

S3$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(S3$junction_aa)
```

```{r}
results <- read.csv("~/Downloads/VHH-Query-Clone-Results09Feb24.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

tmp <- read.csv("~/Downloads/VHH-Query-Clone-Tallies09Feb24.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```

```{r}
CDR3_id <- vector()
CDR3_seq <- vector()
clones <- vector()
counts <- vector()


for (nm in unique(tmp$Query_sequence_name)){
  print(nm)
  print(results[results$Query_sequence_name == nm,]$Query_junction_aa[1])
  tmp_frame <- tmp[tmp$Query_sequence_name == nm,]
  print(nrow(tmp_frame))
  tmp_frame$clone_id <- factor(tmp_frame$clone_id)
  print(table(tmp_frame$clone_id))
  print(length(table(tmp_frame$clone_id)))
  
  CDR3_id <- c(CDR3_id, nm)
  CDR3_seq <- c(CDR3_seq, results[results$Query_sequence_name == nm,]$Query_junction_aa[1])
  clone_list <- as.vector(as.character(names(table(tmp_frame$clone_id))))
  clones <- c(clones, paste(clone_list, collapse = ', '))
  counts <- c(counts, length(as.numeric(table(tmp_frame$clone_id))))
  
  cat("\n")
  cat("\n")
  
}

results_frame <- as.data.frame(cbind(CDR3_id, CDR3_seq,clones, counts))
results_frame$counts <- as.numeric(as.character(results_frame$counts))
results_frame <- results_frame[order(results_frame$counts, decreasing = T),]
```
